item.title: Free legal advice on NC 4-All Service Day
item.description: GREENVILLE, N.C. (WNCT) -- The North Carolina Bar Foundation is hosting its annual 4-All Statewide Day of Service. The service will provide free legal information to the public via a hotline answered by professional lawyers. The hotline will be open from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m., and all calls will be confidential and free.
